title: B2B SaaS GTM Architecture — Nordics & CEE
description: GTM architecture for a B2B SaaS expansion: vendor intelligence, ICP definition, Poland market entry, and outbound/inbound infrastructure built from scratch.
problem: Expansion into new markets with no existing pipeline, no local brand presence, and no structured GTM motion beyond product-led assumptions.
system: Full GTM system: ICP definition, vendor intelligence workflow, inbound/outbound architecture, CRM structure, and sales enablement stack — built before first outbound sequence went out.
artifact: Market entry playbook, ICP matrix, outbound sequences, CRM structure, and a vendor intelligence workflow that runs continuously.
outcome: Structured pipeline motion replacing intuition-based outreach; repeatable research-to-sequence flow for each new market segment.
